dedupe_keys.name: shark nationell miljoovervakning av hamnsal i sverige sedan 1988

description: SHARK - Nationell miljöövervakning av hamnsäl i Sverige sedan 1988 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. The national monitoring program was initiated by the Swedish Environmental Protection Agency and is now financed by the Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management. The monitoring is performed by the Swedish Museum of Natural History. Data is stored in the database SHARK, hosted and maintained by the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute. Coverage: Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. The portal shows the English title as "SHARK - National environmental monitoring of Harbour seal in Sweden since 1988" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. Its keywords include Samplingevent, SAMPLING_EVENT. The listing shows 2025-04-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
